conclusions.text: Eight GEOIDs each map one-to-one to the eight scoped Atlas ADM2 records, Census STATE 13, expected names and stable Georgia parent; 2026 County/Eq. LSADC 06 and FUNCSTAT A support identity and tier only.

Coastal five Atlas/Census IoU gaps are stable from 2018 through 2026 and projected excess area is a substantial fraction of Census AREAWATER, consistent with water-extent convention differences; exact territorial boundary and shoreline completeness remain unresolved.
Schley, Pike, and Terrell original Census references are invalid self-intersecting rings in 2018, 2025, and 2026; Atlas geometries are valid. This diagnoses the comparator, not Atlas correctness.
No scoped county entity appears in the retained selected Georgia change notes; this absence does not prove no legal or shoreline change because Census notes are selected and non-exhaustive.

No engineering geometry correction can be substantiated without a legal Georgia county boundary source that defines offshore water/island treatment and a valid reference for the three invalid comparator rows.
